name: uniquel
description: Use this when a coding agent is editing a Next.js or React project styled with Tailwind CSS and needs component or section source to add to the repo. Do not use for design advice, mockups, or UI questions when no codebase is open.

interface.longDescription: Use this when Codex is writing code in a Next.js or React app styled with Tailwind CSS. Search the Uniquel catalog and insert the source for a component or page section into the project. Do not use it in a chat with no codebase, or for design feedback, mockups, and layout ideas.
defaultPrompt: Find a free Uniquel component that would improve this project, then show me the best match before adding it.
